main_text.l: ulla deflectione possunt, Audi nos benigne[?] Pater,

l.i: & pro omnipotenti tua bonitate concede, ut ita benedicas
& sanctifices verbo tuo, & spiritu tuo sancto hæc tua dona, has
tuas creaturas panis & vini, ut sint nobis corpus & sanguis

main_text.l: dilecti filii tui, &c. quæ sunt formalia verba Canonis
Missæ. In eadem precatione margini apponuntur
hæc, Presbyter officiaris sumet seu tollat patinam in ma-

l.i: nus, dum hoc est corpus meum repetitur, & calicem, dum

main_text.l: dicitur hic est sanguis novi Testamenti, finita consecra-
tione immediatè subjungitur memoriale, seu oratio
oblationis (quæ in missali Romano vocatur oblatio
rememorativa) in qua dicitur, Christum voluisse nos

l.i: illud memoriale celebrare in memoriam, non solum beatæ
passionis, sed & potentis resurrectionis, gloriosæ ascensionis,

main_text.l: &c. &, ut verbo dicam, quantum declinat hic liber
ab Anglico, tanto propius accedit ad missale Ro-
manum, plurimas alias mutationes in deterius ob-
servarunt Scoti, & profitentur apertè, se probaturos
omnes materiales partes canonis missæ, seminaliter
ibi positas, & parvo temporis intervallo missam
posse inde fabricari.
Sed redeo ad narrationem, defunctus necessaria
hac excursione, quia librorum horum in sequenti-
bus frequentissima futura est mentio, utpote, quod
omnibus hisce dissidiis causam dederint, Episcopis
omni conatu urgentibus, ut ab Ecclesiis reciperen-
tur, nullo præeunte Synodi Nationalis examine
aut judicio, cujus consensum se nunquam obtentu-
ros sciebant, itaque denuo, ad supremum Regis se-
natum confugiunt, cujus mandato omnes jubentur
regio mandato parere, cum certificatione (ut ita
loquar) nisi in usum Parœciarum singuli Pastores
duo exemplaria comparent, se interdicturos eis
aqua & igni, rebelliumque poenas non evasuros. In-
terim vero quidam Episcoporum, non expectato
die à Rege præfinito (Paschatis festo) statim ea li-tur.

page.notes: The printed text is set in a single column. A printed mark (an asterisk-like sign) stands at the start of the paragraph beginning "Sed redeo"; it is not transcribed as text. The running head is partly covered by a library stamp and the word after "SCOTI" is unclear; the final letter is read as Æ with doubt. "benigne" is partly obscured by a stamp at the top of the page. Faint dashes and the letters "ex" at the far right edge near the bottom are edge marks or show-through, not margin notes, and are not transcribed. A stray mark at the lower left is not text. The word "tur." at the foot of the text is the completion of "litur" broken across lines, so it is treated as part of the final paragraph and not as a catchword.
